title: [3.3.0-dev-e] Fallback to profile sensitivity notification
symptom: Once a day the user receives a notification that there is not enough TDD data and it falls back to profile sensitivity, despite TDD data being available. The user is using the SMB plugin.
cause: The reason is that data is coming delayed from xDrip, e.g., AAPS received a BG with timestamp 16:42:03 at 16:47:15. This delay causes the TDD data to appear insufficient at that moment.
fix: The developer improved the message in dev, but no specific fix was provided to prevent the notification. The user suggests it would be nice if the notification could be suppressed or not shown in this instance.
evidence_quote: In your case the reason is that data is comming delayed from xdrip ie. 16:47:15 AAPS received BG with timestamp 16:42:03 There is nothing I can do with this
